what: Hovering a grain-line border button (1px, 3.5px corners) makes another border 4px outside spread out, starting from cloud clumps — a 60-frame noise-threshold sprite is laid as a mask and the frames are stepped straight (in .7s, out .35s, proportional to the remaining distance). The text exits −120% upward with .8s expo-out while the same text rises from 120% below. look: fill makes the inside of the button fill like clouds instead of the border, and the letters take the background color

options.reveal: Length of the spread to the end (s), default .7
options.ring: When off, no outer border, only the grain border and text lines
options.look: If fill, the inside fills up (--fx-fill · --fx-fill-ink)
options.radius: Corner radius (px), default 3.5 — outer border is +.75
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text to roll — if none, nothing rolls
options.--fx-stroke · --fx-stroke-opacity · --fx: Border color, opacity, outer border color (via style), default --kf-dim · 1 · --kf-ink-soft
options.--fx-roll-dur · --fx-roll-ease: Text line duration · curve, default .8s · cubic-bezier(.14,1,.34,1)

from.where: shared.js .ow-btn (Enter · View work · Back · REEL) — original BtnLink · BtnToggle (spritesheet 60 frames mask-size 6000% · revealDuration .7 · hideDuration .35 · text line .8s var(--expo-out) 120%)

note: Instead of the original sprite images, the same 60 frames are baked on the spot with value noise — the cloud pattern differs but the frame count and transitions are the same
